keyless_reason: GET /provider/v1/models answers 200 without auth (verified 2026-09-25); only inference needs COMMANDCODE_API_KEY

plan_tier_policy.reason: CommandCode is per_token PAYG pass-through (plan_terms: 'per_token PAYG pass-through at 1:1 vs models.dev stickers'), NOT a subscription pool — plan_tier stays null like the other 67 commandcode lanes (a numeric tier re-buckets PAYG lanes and changes chain order)

sticker_prices._note: CommandCode's /models catalog carries NO pricing block. Its contract is documented 1:1 pass-through of the VENDOR list sticker (see the rows' 'research:commandcode-no-markup models.dev-sticker' evidence), so net-new lanes take the modal models.dev sticker for that exact model id (counted across providers 2026-09-25). Prices in USD per 1M tokens. A model absent here stays UNPRICED (documented gap) rather than guessed.

notes: onboarded as a preset 2026-09-25 so commandcode refreshes stop being one-off edits: the carrier is NOT on models.dev (no provider id), so the catalog + sticker_prices block are its only data sources
the :free lanes and stealth lanes keep the F3 window-cost rule (a $0 sticker never flattens an established window cost)
supported_endpoints in the catalog is metadata only — never mapped to registry columns (a list value in a typed column kills the seed)
